title: pvExtractSubsetWithSeed
body:
## pvExtractSubsetWithSeed

From a structured grid (vtkStructuredGrid, including multiblock structured data split across blocks or processes), extracts the grid line (I, J or K) or grid surface (IJ, JK or KI) that passes through the cell containing Seed, following it across block boundaries even when block i-j-k origins differ. Typical use: pick a point to extract a wall-normal grid line or a constant-k surface of a curvilinear CFD mesh. Output keeps the structured cells, as a partitioned dataset for a single grid or the input's composite type otherwise.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- A seed outside every cell extracts nothing; place it inside the grid.
- Only structured grids are accepted; use pvExtractSubset or extractSubset for index ranges of image or rectilinear data.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ExtractSubsetWithSeed`. Identity: `filters/ExtractSubsetWithSeed`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: curvilinear structured grids (vtkStructuredGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkStructuredGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Direction` | Specify the direction in which to extract the slice starting with the **Seed**. | `{"type":"enum","values":["I","J","K","IJ","JK","KI"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"I"` |
| `Seed` | Specify the seed point in x-y-z coordinates to initiate in the slice extraction. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
